title: Maintenance, Claim Filing and Appeal Terms of the Harbison Protection Contracts Tiers
content:
Each Harbison Protection Contracts tier fixes whether a claim needs documented maintenance, how much time may pass between maintenance and a failure, how long after a diagnosis a claim can be filed, and how long after a decision an appeal can be decided.

| Tier | Documented maintenance required | Maintenance interval | Grace days | Claim filing deadline | Appeal window | Appeals per claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | no | 12 months | 90 days | 30 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | yes | 12 months | 90 days | 30 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | yes | 12 months | 90 days | 30 days | 30 days | 1 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | yes | 12 months | 90 days | 60 days | 45 days | 1 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | 12 months | 90 days | 60 days | 45 days | 1 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | 12 months | 90 days | 90 days | 60 days | 1 |

**Column definitions.**

- *Maintenance interval*: the longest span, in months, allowed between the most recent documented maintenance and the failure, before grace.
- *Grace days*: calendar days added to the maintenance interval. On every tier the allowed span is therefore 12 months plus 90 days.
- *Claim filing deadline*: calendar days after the failure is diagnosed within which a claim must be filed.
- *Appeal window*: calendar days after the original decision within which an appeal may be decided.
- *Appeals per claim*: the number of appeals allowed on one claim.

**Records accepted as documented maintenance (every tier).** A completed Comfort Club tune-up on the unit, or a paid precision tune-up service call on the unit. No other record is listed.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A failure diagnosed on a Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract has 90 calendar days for filing, against 60 on the Harbison 12-Year Total Protection and 30 on the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection.
